name: MultiMedQA
intro: MultiMedQA 是 Google Research 等提出的综合医疗问答评测套件：最终发表版汇集六个既有英文数据集，并发布含 3,173 条消费者健康搜索问题的 HealthSearchQA；评测分别覆盖四组多选任务的准确率、140 题长回答的临床医生盲审，以及普通用户对意图匹配和有用性的评分。
org: Google Research, DeepMind, National Library of Medicine
build_method: 数据集汇编, 搜索建议整理, 临床医生盲审, 普通用户评测
metric: 多选准确率, 临床医生多维评分, 普通用户意图与有用性评分
task_type: 医疗问答, 多项选择, 长回答
eval_feature: 七数据集套件, HealthSearchQA, 多种提示策略, 临床医生盲审与普通用户评测
scale: 7 个数据集；发表版 HealthSearchQA 3,173 条；人工评测子集 140 题
openness_en: Partly Public (HealthSearchQA supplement is public under the article's CC BY 4.0; source-dataset terms vary; Med-PaLM code and weights are withheld)
task_type_en: Medical QA, Multiple Choice, Long-form Answers
build_method_en: Dataset Compilation, Search-suggestion Curation, Blinded Clinician Review, Lay-user Evaluation
eval_feature_en: Seven-dataset Suite, HealthSearchQA, Multiple Prompting Strategies, Blinded Clinician and Lay-user Review
intro_en: MultiMedQA is a broad medical question-answering suite introduced by Google Research and collaborators. The version of record combines six existing English datasets and releases HealthSearchQA with 3,173 consumer health-search questions; evaluation covers accuracy on four multiple-choice groups, blinded clinician review of 140 long-form questions, and lay-user ratings of intent and helpfulness.
scale_en: 7 datasets; 3,173 HealthSearchQA questions in the version of record; 140-question human-evaluation subset
metric_en: Multiple-choice Accuracy, Multiaxis Clinician Ratings, Lay-user Intent and Helpfulness Ratings
drawio_review_note: Evidence lock and priority. This source-only redraw treats the open-access Nature version of record, “Large language models encode clinical knowledge,” Nature 620, 172–180 (2023), DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06291-2, as controlling evidence, and uses arXiv:2212.13138v1 only to document the preprint divergence. The fixed Nature PDF URL is https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-023-06291-2.pdf and its downloaded SHA-256 is 969d7f5ae18a244a4fc156914e6200c4962fac11132ac6a9a2518ae58e4741d4. The fixed Supplementary Information PDF URL is https://static-content.springer.com/esm/art%3A10.1038%2Fs41586-023-06291-2/MediaObjects/41586_2023_6291_MOESM1_ESM.pdf with SHA-256 feaffa009f732a9baa297950f4babd7d8955c411405714fd66d539f8997db0ba. The released HealthSearchQA workbook is https://static-content.springer.com/esm/art%3A10.1038%2Fs41586-023-06291-2/MediaObjects/41586_2023_6291_MOESM6_ESM.xlsx with SHA-256 a89f6639ee76717e2a1ea25bbe25c8c69cf396681be76fd8145da7e9c8917e1e. The arXiv v1 PDF SHA-256 is e83a6fecf5820a49b2b1c716f4c1839a7301300a6e27aa53c3cb7212b7db9f4e. Construction evidence comes from the Nature Key contributions; Methods sections “MultiMedQA benchmark” and “HealthSearchQA”; Extended Data Table 1; Data availability; and the released workbook. MultiMedQA combines MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, six MMLU clinical topics, LiveQA, and MedicationQA with HealthSearchQA. The formats deliberately remain heterogeneous: multiple-choice and long-form, open-domain and closed-domain, with PubMedQA requiring its abstract context. The paper explicitly says that legacy explanations or long-form references from MedMCQA, PubMedQA, LiveQA, and MedicationQA were not used as a common ground truth because their sources were inconsistent and sometimes automated or non-clinician. HealthSearchQA was built from seed medical conditions and associated symptoms, which were used to retrieve publicly visible search-engine suggestions shown to all users. The Nature version reports 3,173 question-only, free-text, open-domain rows. Direct inspection of the fixed supplementary workbook found 3,173 non-empty question rows, 3,156 unique strings, and 17 duplicated question rows; its second sheet contains the 140 MultiMedQA human-evaluation questions. No undocumented deduplication is inserted into the flow. Evaluation evidence comes from the Nature Results sections on prompting and human evaluation, Methods on the human framework and modelling, Extended Data Tables 2–3, Figs. 2–6, and Supplementary Information. The multiple-choice branch covers MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and the MMLU clinical topics. Few-shot and chain-of-thought prompting are compared. The paper fixes self-consistency at 11 decodes for MedQA, MedMCQA, and PubMedQA; it also applies self-consistency to MMLU, but does not state that the same 11-decode count applies there, so the node intentionally limits that number to the three disclosed datasets. The long-form branch randomly selects 100 HealthSearchQA, 20 LiveQA, and 20 MedicationQA questions, disjoint from instruction-prompt-tuning exemplars. One clinician panel writes reference answers; Flan-PaLM 540B and Med-PaLM 540B produce the other two answer sets; a different panel evaluates the three sources blind, with one clinician rating each answer and nine clinicians across the USA, UK, and India. Clinician axes include scientific consensus; harm extent and likelihood; correct and incorrect comprehension, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning; inappropriate or incorrect content; missing content; and bias. Five non-expert raters in India separately score whether answers address user intent and are helpful or actionable. The version of record uses 1,000 non-parametric bootstrap replicas and 95% percentile intervals. Version boundary. arXiv v1 reports 3,375 HealthSearchQA questions and 100 bootstrap replicas, whereas Nature reports 3,173 and 1,000 bootstrap replicas. The diagram uses the final Nature values and names both preprint values only in the evidence legend/review boundary; it does not silently merge them. Availability boundary. Nature states that the six source datasets are open source and releases HealthSearchQA as a supplementary file. The article and its author-created supplement are published under CC BY 4.0, while third-party/source datasets retain their own terms. The paper explicitly withholds Med-PaLM code and weights for safety reasons, and no versioned end-to-end evaluation harness or official leaderboard is disclosed. Accordingly the catalog says partly public rather than implying a uniformly licensed, fully executable benchmark package. Formal publication evidence [site-a11w-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2415×665 (English) and 2393×665 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2413×663 and 2391×663. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
